api_for_a11.serialization: LinkResolution is a module-local ContractModel and supports model_dump(mode='json'). Nested link/mapping/review/provenance shapes use the frozen A02 contracts. RelationshipJob is an in-memory definition/request carrier, not a new runner callback or saved prep format.

behavior: Unique datasheet filename matches precede normalized original-filename/title matches to custom BOM names. Name normalization ignores case/separators without translating names or using unapproved section/material mappings.

Repeated filenames in either inventory, normalized-name collisions, BOM identity_conflict and duplicate stable row names never auto-select. A title cannot bypass the two actual RecoaterPlate.pdf attachment references.

The domain validator independently checks exact drawing ownership, actual unique custom row membership, candidate shape/state, each returned row and paired recorded name/attachment evidence. A section/material resemblance alone cannot support a relationship. Values are never repaired; only validation flags and the candidate digest change.

No-match uses the explicit drawing_id/bom_rows=[] candidate and requires cited full candidate inventory, absence of actual anchors, a usable title when candidates exist and no excluded custom identity. Unknown/unsupported remains unresolved. Multiple selected rows require separate evidence for every row.

Jobs use M08 JobDefinition, EvidenceBundle, EvidenceInput, definition.request and with_field_validation exactly as accepted. Sol determines; Opus verifies that exact candidate against original evidence. M08 alone owns the one disagreement correction/reverification, failure policy, cache, timing and resource accounting.

Each job supplies canonical typed original evidence projections and admissible source IDs. Link jobs include their drawing plus the full eligible custom candidate inventory and explicit excluded custom identities. Mapping jobs include their recorded name pairs, occurrence counts and complete retained link inventory. No PDF is regenerated.

Drawing manifest path/hash/subsystem/original filename are checked against deterministic DrawingEvidence. Producer inputs are snapshotted. Requests bind the full registry digest, pipeline/domain version, actual projected JSON bytes, attached original image bytes, fixed field/schema/prompt and completed-link candidate identities.

AI-read title/notes/material fields require original image inputs with hashes present in their retained source identity. Those supplied images are attached to both ordered stages through M08. Changed image bytes invalidate the registry/job instead of being relabeled as verifier failure.

Post-link mapping jobs propose same, kind_of, different or no_equivalent for observed recorded name pairs. kind_of is directed from specific from_name to broader to_name; no_equivalent uses null to_name. Section counts describe recorded associations, not human approval.

Every material semantic proposal is labeled general_engineering_knowledge, not dataset evidence. Mapping validation proves the names/linked occurrences are recorded; material taxonomy remains an outside-dataset proposal for Opus and human review.

The handoff revalidates retained M08 provenance and current candidate source validation. Stale source/job/prompt/contract/candidate bindings cannot be replayed. Historical blind-reader methods/cache are never imported or promoted.

Only M08's genuine execution-failure fallback can produce AI_SINGLE_MODEL. The review handoff explicitly says UNVERIFIED and retains the failed Opus attempt/next-launch retry. Disagreement, uncertainty, invalid IDs or unsupported source evidence never authorize fallback.
No decision is appended, mapping approved, fact/search index changed, generated output published, CLI launched or application API key read by this module.
source_validation_limits: Semantic translations without a recorded lexical/attachment anchor are unsupported even if a model is sure; they stay unresolved for human review.
Observed linked name pairs are proposals. The source validator does not assert that a material taxonomy is printed in the dataset or independently certify outside engineering knowledge.
There is no inferred no-equivalent mapping for an unlinked or absent name based solely on missing link coverage. No expected engineering answer or approved mapping is seeded.
Actual corpus relationship candidates, Opus verification and human decisions have not been executed or fabricated by this coding lane.
